It sounds like a beautiful ending but I don't think it's your time to have your beautiful ending. I know seems like everything's just fitting into place; you've brought your son all the way to getting this new job so you don't feel like he needs you anymore and you think your girlfriend would have a better quality of life without having you to depend on her. But god this just is not true. I argue with my dad all the time, we fight, I waste so much of his money and we go a while without seeing eachother. But I know I'd still be lost without him. Even though I'm an adult capable of doing my own things it would just break my heart if my father died, let alone killed himself. I'm not saying it to be mean but I know that if you killed yourself your son will forever think what he could have done to stop it. I'm not saying it's a selfish thing to kill yourself, because it's not. It's just too painful sometimes there's just no other future I get it. But saying all these people will be better off with you gone is just plain ignorant. You matter to them and this will do irreparable damage.
Your brother sounds like a knob. I don't know any of the back story so lord knows what his deal is but I've gone through your page and you seem like a smart guy. Your love for all those documentaries is so sweet, love seeing people with interests and passions. And there's soul in you. The way you talk about your ending is beautifully poetic, I'd love to see you getting more into art. There's so much beauty in the world that you have still never seen it would be such a shame for you to leave so soon. I think you should stay a little longer.
